decisions.reason: A black-finish range is a low-cost variant of the established offer that fits current bathroom design trends, and with industry turnover growing it faces no shortfall against aspirations that would trigger search for other uses of its resources.
The shower channel for seamless coverings sits at the core of the firm's barrier-free bathroom strategy and has a page of its own, so it likely meets aspirations and slack easily covers it.

The pump-assisted line moves further from the core and its results are still uncertain, but a growing industry and the firm's slack allow it to be carried while it serves renovation cases where gravity drainage is not possible.
The tileable floor drain is close to the established offer, uses existing manufacturing and installer channels, and gives no performance signal below aspiration that would justify dropping it.
The stainless steel design grate fits the firm's design-led positioning and own metal manufacturing at little extra cost, so management keeps it in the absence of any shortfall.
